persons.name: Bhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrījaya bhūpatīndramalladevasana cukacāsa devapratiṣṭhā siddhāgni aitāhuti yajña yāṅāyā thva sāphuri

date.as_written: saṃ 825 bhādra pade śukla daśamī, mūla śaniścaravārakuhnuḥ

notes: The manuscript was copied/used for the installation ritual and sacrifice (devapratiṣṭhā siddhāgni aitāhuti yajña) performed by King Bhūpatīndra Malla of Bhaktapur in Cukacā (a courtyard in the palace compound).
